# Administrative Systems

This area groups the foundational administrative identifiers and reporting frameworks that underpin Danish healthcare registries, particularly within the context of acute surgery. It covers the central civil registration system used for patient matching and dataset exclusions, alongside the clinical protocols and national reporting guidelines that standardize how quality indicators and patient data are submitted to health authorities.

## Pages

- [[topics/administrative-systems/danish-civil-registration/index|Danish Civil Registration]] — Foundational administrative identifiers and clinical reporting frameworks, including the civil registration number, ERAS protocols, and National Patient Register guidelines.
